title: Wgpu Panel Glass Blur
description: Restore real frosted-glass panels in the wgpu renderer (side panel, context menus/dropdowns, window measures/engagement rails) via GPU backdrop-blur + saturate + tint composite.
summary: Restored real frosted-glass panels in the wgpu renderer via GPU backdrop-blur + saturate + tint composite. Added glass menu/window-options alpha and blur/saturate metrics to tokens.json and regenerated styling artifacts. Replaced opaque glass_panel_fill/overlay_bg fills with per-tier GlassStyle (Panel/Menu/WindowOptions) and DrawList::push_glass. Implemented offscreen mip-chained scene_color_texture, blur downsample chain, scene blit, and glass composite passes in ui/wgpu draw/gpu pipeline. Migrated side panel, context menus/dropdowns/palette, window measures/engagement rails, and select popups to push_glass. cargo test -p ui_wgpu -p ui_styling passed; wasm rebuild succeeded.
